name: sdd-evolution-harness-engineering
description: Interactive, harness-driven workshop that teaches Spec-Driven Development evolution: build computational guides and sensors, the four-stage RPIV pipeline (Research, Plan, Implement, Verify), drift detection, draft-acceptance scaffolders, and brownfield onboarding via a Copilot CLI extension with a POSIX-bash offline fallback.
author: jsburckhardt
prerequisites: Comfort with git plumbing (worktrees, hooks, rebase, reset)
Read AGENTS.md and at least one ADR in this repository
Devcontainer with flock, jq, node, and check-jsonschema
objectives: Drive Research, Plan, Implement, and Verify stages from a single command surface
Install computational sensors that gate commits on RPIV invariants
Detect harness drift across the six git triggers and reconcile state
Scaffold ADRs and core-components as draft candidates that never auto-mutate canonical files
Inspect a repository through the 2×2 (computational/inferential × guides/sensors) lens
Onboard a brownfield project safely with symlink-escape refusal and secret redaction
Operate fully offline through the bash entrypoint when the Copilot SDK is unavailable
